title: The Haters
author: Jesse Andrews
current_text: In 2022, the Alpine School District banned The Haters following the implementation of Utah law H.B. 374, “Sensitive Materials In Schools.”

sources.quote: In 2022, The Haters was listed among 52 novels banned by the Alpine School District following the implementation of Utah law H.B. 374, “Sensitive Materials In Schools."
